result.title: A method to automatically discover symbolic local learning rules
result.summary: We present a general method for discovering symbolic local learning rules that can replace backpropagation, applicable, in principle, to any deep learning architecture and task. The method automatically discovers local loss functions specific to each layer by (1) constructing a dictionary of monomials of local tensor variables, inspired by Penrose diagram notation, (2) regressing over coefficients weighting these monomials to build layerwise polynomial losses whose gradients together minimize a target global loss. We test the method on classification, reconstruction, and self-supervised learning tasks with small multilayer networks and minimal datasets. Across all tasks, the discovered rules induce non-trivial interactions between layers, which lead to significant reductions in the corresponding global losses. Furthermore, the method selects sparse combinations of monomials, finding local rules that are more interpretable than those generated by MLP-based alternatives. The potential implications of our method range from energy-efficient deep learning to the discovery of biologically plausible learning mechanisms.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种自动发现符号化局部学习规则的方法：以 Penrose 图示记为灵感构造局部张量变量的单项式字典，再回归系数得到逐层多项式损失，使其梯度共同最小化全局目标，并在分类、重建与自监督小规模任务上验证得到稀疏且可解释的层间交互规则。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「逐层局部损失替代全局反传」的符号化搜索思路，可供核查 LVR 中多步 latent 状态或层级的局部监督与贡献分配如何设计，但原文只做通用小网络实验，与视觉推理无直接关联。
